title: Book Club with Author Jess Kidd
content: Have you read Jess Kidd's latest books? Join our special Book Club author event during the festival, where you can ask the author directly your usual book club questions! To make the most of the event, consider reading one of Jess Kidd's novels beforehand. Alternatively, just come to discover what a book club is all about and to hear Jess discuss the ideas behind her creative vision.

title: Story Tea
content: Let professional storyteller Pyn Stockman guide you on an extraordinary storytelling journey while you brew your own ‘StoryTea’ in a Staffordshire-made cup. As you listen to the story, ingredients mentioned throughout the book will become part of your unique story tea, which you can enjoy while sitting back and relaxing to the audible tale.

title: Stoke Book Club: Book Chat
content: No book festival is complete without launching a new book club. Join the Stoke Book Festival’s Book Club and begin your journey into books.

title: Charity Shop trail with Verity Babbs
content: Before Verity Babbs's evening performance, her viral social media content about Charity Shops will be live from Stoke. Join Verity on a walk about town as she guides you through charity shopping, sharing tips on finding the best bargains and what to look out for.

title: Shakespeare Words & Music with CSSO
content: A lively performance by the City of Stoke-on-Trent Symphony Orchestra who will take you on a musical journey inspired by Shakespeare's words that have sparked melodic notes. Enjoy a blend of music, Shakespeare, and a great time with artistic director Joe Hearson.

title: Take 10 to Read
content: Each year on 10 October for World Mental Health Day the National Literacy Trust call on the nation to #Take10ToRead. Join us on the festival Saturday with your favourite book (or a new one) and join us at one of our venues, Stoke Minster or Stoke Library for free Event refreshment a moment of peace and tranquillity inside or outside and take 10 to read.

title: Letters to Myself
content: Kate Leake, Stoke-on-Trent’s creative Laureate, is also a book illustrator and author. She will host the ‘Letters to Myself’ Workshop at Stoke Market, where participants will write a letter, poem, or prose dedicated to themselves. The festival will post these to you a year later! It’s a chance to reflect on the past or envision your future, with creative tips and inspiration from Kate as you illustrate your message, hopefully bringing a smile to your future self. All Ages - children accompanied by an adult

title: Local author mixer
content: Are you an author or writer based in North Staffordshire? The Stoke Book Festival is hosting a mixer event where you can meet fellow local writers, receive advice and tips from publishers and published authors. Join us for refreshments and conversation to support your writing journey.
